description: Search MSHA's open government data by mine name, operator name or controller name, or by exact MSHA mine ID, optionally in one state. The tool returns each mine's ID, name, operator, controller, county, state, mine type, commodity and MSHA status. It holds only mines with operator hours reported to MSHA for 2016 or a later year. It orders results by name, then mine ID, never by rate or by count.

limit.description: How many results to return, 25 at most.

query.description: Mine, operator or controller name (at least two characters), or an MSHA mine ID.

name: search_mines
title: Search mines
